title: Tech Gone Wild
description: Members explored unusual tech ideas, pitched the worst startup they could imagine, and left with possible project ideas of their own.

title: AI & Data Visualization Sprint
description: Teams used real datasets from NASA, Spotify, Netflix, and Charlotte crime data to find insights and build visualizations in Google Colab.

title: Show & Tell
description: Students shared personal projects—finished or unfinished—through live demos, quick presentations, and conversations about their tech stacks.

title: Web Development Competition
description: Teams of one or two received a surprise topic, built a working website with any frontend tools they wanted, and presented it before the night ended.
imageAlt: HAVK competition participants holding their certificates
